title: Indicative demo and pilot costs
note: Concept demo / MVP: £2,500–£3,500 over 2–3 weeks. One programme, clickable learner/company screens, one recap or mini-lesson/nudge example and one scripted roleplay with separate feedback. This is a reviewable demonstration, not a live learner service. Working pilot: £7,500–£12,000 over around 2 months, after scope/content approval, for one programme and approximately 30–50 learners across small cohorts. Scope includes learner access, preparation, approved follow-up, one live AI scenario, basic records/reporting and trainer approval. These are indicative estimates, not confirmed quotes or delivery promises; VAT excluded. Agree a total cap, format and content/AI/voice/avatar/hosting/support allowances. Demo and pilot are separate scopes; moving between them needs an agreed scope and total cost, with no assumed fee credit or automatic commitment. No long-term platform prices are proposed; review results before agreeing further work.

title: Proposed journey, fictional data and pilot scope
note: Proposed lightweight LMS: one learner account across enrolled courses, company/course participation views and a trainer approval workflow. All Sarah/Northstar records, schedules, confidence ratings and statuses are fictional. Difficult Conversations: 20 enrolments, 18 attendances, 15 activations, 12 reinforcement completions, 9 practice completions. Presentation Skills: 12/11/10/8/6 respectively. Combined: 32/29/25/20/15; these are course enrolments, not unique people. The concept demo is limited to reviewable screens, one content/nudge example and scripted practice. Proposed working pilot: 30–50 learners across small cohorts, not one large workshop. Smart nudges may include approved videos, personalised mini-lessons, questions and reminders. Live conversational AI personas, voice/avatar options and persistent coaching require custom development and validation. Instructor likeness/voice is optional and requires explicit consent and governance; licensed alternatives are possible. No live AI, speech or avatar video is implemented in this proposal.
